title: Hinder
wikitext:
{{status
| name                   = Hinder
| type                   = Debuff
| description            = Your Movement Speed is reduced.
}}

'''Hinder''' is a [[debuff]] that reduces [[movement speed]] on the affected target. A creature can only be affected by one Hinder at a time; if a creature is hindered by multiple sources, only the strongest Hinder takes effect.

Hinder is applied by [[spell]]s, just like [[maim]] is by [[attack]]s. Since maim and hinder are different debuffs, an enemy can be affected by both simultaneously.<ref name="220Patch"/>

By default, hindered enemies have 30% reduced [[movement speed]], and the debuff lasts for 4 seconds. Some unique items, skill gems, and flask modifiers have another specified debuff value and duration in their modifier text, however.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|2.1.0|
* Spells that reduce movement speed now do so with a new debuff called "Hinder". You can only have one Hinder effect on you at once, so multiple movement-slowing spells will not stack. This is currently used on {{il|Infernal Cry|Abyssal Cry}} and the new {{il|Wither}} skill.
}}
